{"rule_yaml": "title: PowerShell launched by Outlook with Bypass and Hidden
id: 4f2a1b3c-5d6e-7f8g-9h0i-j1k2l3m4n5o6
status: experimental
description: Detects PowerShell execution initiated by Outlook.exe using ExecutionPolicy Bypass and WindowStyle Hidden, as observed in INC-2026-0417.
logsource:
    product: windows
    category: process_creation
detection:
    selection:
        ParentImage|endswith: '\OUTLOOK.EXE'
        Image|endswith: '\powershell.exe'
        CommandLine|contains: 'ExecutionPolicy Bypass'
        CommandLine|contains: 'WindowStyle Hidden'
    condition: selection
fields:
    - ComputerName
    - User
    - CommandLine
    - ParentImage
    - Image
falsepositives:
    - Legitimate administrative scripts launched via Outlook (rare)
level: high
tags:
    - attack.execution
    - attack.t1059.001"}

{"rule_text": "rule PowerShell_AMSI_Bypass_Persistence {
    meta:
        description = "Detects PowerShell script with AMSI bypass and persistence capabilities"
        author = "SOC Analyst N2"
        incident = "INC-2026-0417"
        reference = "C7"

    strings:
        $amsi_bypass = "amsiInitFailed"
        $reg_persistence = "Set-ItemProperty"
        $reg_path = "Software\\Microsoft\\Windows\\CurrentVersion\\Run"
        $task_persistence = "New-ScheduledTaskAction"
        $task_trigger = "New-ScheduledTaskTrigger"
        $hidden_window = "-WindowStyle Hidden"

    condition:
        all of them
}"}

{"rule_text": "rule PowerShell_AMSI_Bypass_Persistence {
